parameters.name: fS
parameters.description: dilaton decay constant f [GeV], eta^-1 = f/v = 1 benchmark, Eq.(3)

parameters.name: mixsS
parameters.description: sin(theta_S) for the h-S field rotation, Eq.(3)

parameters.name: mixcS
parameters.description: cos(theta_S) for the h-S field rotation, Eq.(3)

parameters.name: mixsL
parameters.description: sin(theta_L) for the t-T field rotation, Eq.(8)

parameters.name: mixcL
parameters.description: cos(theta_L) for the t-T field rotation, Eq.(8)

parameters.name: kap
parameters.value: Abs[MH^2 - MS^2]/(2 fS vev) Abs[Sin[2 thS]]

parameters.name: lamS
parameters.value: 3 Abs[MH^2 - MS^2]/(2 fS^2) (Abs[(MH^2 + MS^2)/(MH^2 - MS^2)] - Sign[Sin[2 thS]] Cos[2 thS])
parameters.description: lambda_S from f, v, theta_S, mh, ms, Eq.(4)

parameters.name: lamH
parameters.value: Abs[MH^2 - MS^2]/vev^2 (Abs[(MH^2 + MS^2)/(MH^2 - MS^2)] + Sign[Sin[2 thS]] Cos[2 thS])
parameters.description: lambda_H from f, v, theta_S, mh, ms, Eq.(4)

definitions: q3L[x1_, 1, a1_] :> Module[{x2, x3}, mixcL ProjM[x1, x2] uq[x2, 3, a1] + mixsL ProjM[x1, x3] Tp[x3, a1]]
q3L[x1_, 2, a1_] :> Module[{x2, ff2}, CKM[3, ff2] ProjM[x1, x2] dq[x2, ff2, a1]]
TLg[x1_, a1_] :> Module[{x2, x3}, -mixsL ProjM[x1, x2] uq[x2, 3, a1] + mixcL ProjM[x1, x3] Tp[x3, a1]]

lagrangian_terms.name: LSdilKin
lagrangian_terms.expression: 1/2 del[Sdil, mu] del[Sdil, mu] - 1/2 MS^2 Sdil^2

lagrangian_terms.name: LPot
lagrangian_terms.expression: Block[{ii, jj}, ExpandIndices[-1/2 kap Sg^2 Phibar[ii] Phi[ii] - lamS/24 Sg^4 - lamH/4 Phibar[ii] Phi[ii] Phibar[jj] Phi[jj], FlavorExpand -> {SU2D, SU2W}]]

lagrangian_terms.name: LTS
lagrangian_terms.expression: -MTp/fS Sg (Tpbar[sp, cc].TLg[sp, cc] + TLgbar[sp, cc].Tp[sp, cc])

lagrangian_terms.name: LYukTp
lagrangian_terms.expression: Block[{sp, ii, jj, cc, yuk}, yuk = ExpandIndices[-yTp Tpbar[sp, cc].q3L[sp, ii, cc] Phi[jj] Eps[ii, jj], FlavorExpand -> SU2D]; yuk + HC[yuk]]
